actions.body: River Ridge Development Authority / Indiana State Board of Accounts
actions.exact_result_status: River Ridge reported that it transferred 619 acres to Meta Platforms in December 2023; the state-filed 2023 RRDA audit separately identifies new 2023 investment of 623.20 acres by Blocke, LLC, consistent with the Meta-affiliated River Ridge data-center site.
actions.access_caveat: RRDA news gives a month-level transfer date and 619-acre figure; the SBOA-filed audit gives 623.20 acres by Blocke, LLC but does not name Meta in the same line.

actions.exact_result_status: IEDC announced Meta's nearly 700,000-square-foot River Ridge facility, construction starting that month, expected 2026 operations, and a 35-year data-center sales-tax exemption for at least $800 million of eligible capital; city and River Ridge incentives were described but not itemized in a vote record.
actions.access_caveat: Official state announcement accessible; it does not link the Clark County/Jeffersonville approval packet or a building permit.

actions.exact_result_status: City announcement described an $800 million, 619-acre campus at River Ridge Commerce Center with a nearly 700,000-square-foot facility, more than 1,200 peak construction jobs, 100 tech jobs, and renewable-energy support.
actions.access_caveat: City news item confirms site scale and location but is not a permit or site-plan packet.

actions.action_type: annual planning report / construction status evidence
actions.exact_result_status: The 2024 Planning and Zoning annual report identified the groundbreaking of Meta's data center at River Ridge as one of the year's largest projects, supporting classification as site work-construction rather than merely announced.
actions.access_caveat: Official annual report confirms groundbreaking but does not include building permit numbers or electrical capacity.

owner: Meta Platforms, Inc.; River Ridge/SBOA records also identify Blocke, LLC as the 2023 land investor for the site

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.description: No official/local-government source found a disclosed MW capacity. Third-party trackers found during refresh variously list 407 MW, 250+ MW, 150 MW, and a separate <10 MW/2.985 MW Blocke LLC record, so capacity_mw remains null pending primary evidence.

Public summaries describe a 619-acre Meta campus/transfer; the SBOA-filed River Ridge 2023 audit identifies 623.20 acres by Blocke, LLC. Difference treated as rounding, affiliated-entity, or transaction-scope variance until deed/parcel records are reviewed.

history.reason: Official IEDC/River Ridge announcement said construction started in January 2024, and the official Jeffersonville Planning and Zoning 2024 annual report later described the project's groundbreaking.

history.new_value: Meta Platforms, Inc.; River Ridge/SBOA records also identify Blocke, LLC as the 2023 land investor for the site
history.reason: Meta/IEDC/city sources identify Meta as the data-center company; RRDA/SBOA records identify the land transaction/investment entity.
